mapper.sql: id, audit_id, trail_id AS audit_trail_id, parent_id AS audit_parent_id, request_id, subject_id, account_id, principal_id, operation, target_type, target_id, result, payload_type, payload_version, payload_json::text AS payload_json, http_method, http_path, client_ip, user_agent, occurred_at, instance_id

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_record_resource r WHERE r.audit_id = audit_record.id AND r.resource_type = #{query.relatedType} AND r.resource_id = #{query.relatedId})

mapper.sql: INSERT INTO audit_record (id, audit_id, trail_id, parent_id, request_id, subject_id, account_id, principal_id, operation, target_type, target_id, result, payload_type, payload_version, payload_json, http_method, http_path, client_ip, user_agent, occurred_at, instance_id) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.auditId}, #{row.auditTrailId}, #{row.auditParentId}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.subjectId}, #{row.accountId}, #{row.principalId}, #{row.operation}, #{row.targetType}, #{row.targetId}, #{row.result}, #{row.payloadType}, #{row.payloadVersion}, CAST(#{row.payloadJson} AS JSONB), #{row.httpMethod}, #{row.httpPath}, #{row.clientIp}, #{row.userAgent}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.instanceId})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM audit_record
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.page.size} OFFSET #{query.page.offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_record_resource (audit_id, resource_type, resource_id, occurred_at) SELECT record.id,refs.type,refs.id,record.occurred_at FROM audit_record record CROSS JOIN (VALUES (#{r.type}::varchar,#{r.id}::varchar)) AS refs(type,id) WHERE record.id = #{id} ON CONFLICT (audit_id, resource_type, resource_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_record_resource WHERE audit_id = #{id} AND resource_type = #{type} AND resource_id = #{resourceId})
SELECT FROM audit_record WHERE id > #{afterId} AND id <= #{throughId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size}
